project_name: MEDICA Private Medical Center Landing Page
data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, inputs, buttons, links, cards, modals, and navigation items MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="nav-link-services", data-testid="hero-appointment-button", data-testid="whatsapp-floating-button", data-testid="appointment-modal-submit-button").

typography.fonts_to_import: Google Fonts: Cormorant Garamond (Serif Display for Editorial Headings) and Plus Jakarta Sans or Manrope (Clean Sans for UI & Body text)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-light tracking-tight text-[#0F2C59]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-light tracking-tight text-[#0F2C59]
hierarchy.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-[#0D9488]

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Grid structure with generous gap (gap-6 to gap-8), subtle 1px border cards, 16px to 24px internal card padding (p-6 to p-8), no heavy rounded corners (max rounded-xl/rounded-2xl).

motion_and_effects.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll or Framer Motion scroll animations for anchor navigation.
motion_and_effects.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal animation on load for the main title.
motion_and_effects.hover_states: Subtle translate-y-1, border color transition to teal accent, shadow elevation.
motion_and_effects.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right button with pulse aura effect.

key_features_to_build.sticky_header: Logo MEDICA, Nav links (Главная, Услуги, Врачи, О центре, Отзывы, Контакты), Phone link (+7 747 310 0916), CTA button 'Записаться'.
key_features_to_build.hero_section: Editorial text + 2 CTAs ('Записаться на приём', 'Написать в WhatsApp') + trust counters + framed doctor photo composition.
key_features_to_build.trust_banner: 10+ направлений, Опытные специалисты, 7 дней в неделю, Удобная онлайн-запись.
key_features_to_build.services_grid: 6 cards: Терапия, Кардиология, Неврология, Педиатрия, УЗИ и диагностика, Лабораторные исследования.
key_features_to_build.doctors_grid: 4 cards with DEMO badge, photo, name, specialization, experience, appointment trigger button.
key_features_to_build.about_section: Asymmetrical layout: large photo + headline 'Медицина с вниманием к человеку' + 3 key advantages.
key_features_to_build.process_section: 4-step visual flow (01 Заявка, 02 Консультация, 03 Диагностика, 04 Лечение & Забота).
key_features_to_build.reviews_section: 3 testimonial cards with mandatory DEMO badge overlay.
key_features_to_build.cta_banner: 'Не откладывайте заботу о здоровье' with WhatsApp and Appointment modal buttons.
key_features_to_build.contacts_section: Address 'ЖК Alma City 5, Алматы', phone '+7 747 310 0916', working hours, interactive map embed for ЖК Alma City 5.
key_features_to_build.footer: Logo, navigation links, contact info, privacy policy notice.
key_features_to_build.appointment_modal: Modal dialog with inputs: Name, Phone, Department. Submit button triggers WhatsApp deep link: https://wa.me/77473100916?text=...
key_features_to_build.floating_whatsapp: Floating bottom-right button redirecting to WhatsApp chat.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all buttons, inputs, links, and text elements have unique kebab-case data-testid attributes.
Do not use dark background as full-page default; use clean off-white (#F8FAFC) with rich dark blue (#0F2C59) and teal (#0D9488) accents.
Always mark Demo reviews and doctor cards with a clear DEMO badge as required in the prompt.
Ensure the appointment modal form redirects directly to wa.me/77473100916 with preformatted Russian text.
Include a floating WhatsApp button in bottom-right corner.
